name: Gelato Network
rootCause: Smart contract automation tool Gelato Network tweeted: "We have been alerted to a critical vulnerability in Sorbet Finance's G-UNI router contract. This vulnerability only affects users interacting with the Sorbet UI." Gelato Network released a security incident investigation report, saying that white hat hackers transferred a total of $27 million in assets to ensure the safety of user assets, but there were still $744,000 of funds that were maliciously attacked by MEV.
